nodes.title: Zoho CRM API request
nodes.description: Call any Zoho CRM API endpoint that has no dedicated operation, e.g. path "/settings/layouts?module=Leads". Only the API's own host is allowed. Agent tools may only read paths under /Leads, /Contacts, /Accounts, /Deals, /Tasks, /Events, /Calls, /Notes, /Products, /Quotes, /Sales_Orders, /Purchase_Orders, /Invoices, /Campaigns, /Vendors, /Price_Books, /Cases, /Solutions, /Appointments__s, /Services__s, /settings/modules, /settings/fields, /settings/layouts, /settings/related_lists, /settings/custom_views, /settings/pipeline, /users, /org.

path.description: Path relative to the API base, starting with "/", e.g. "/settings/layouts?module=Leads"

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none
